items.title: Sr. Business Recruiter, Communications & Marketing
items.description: Perplexity is hiring an experienced Communications & Marketing Recruiter to help build the teams responsible for how our company and products are positioned, launched, explained, and experienced. You will lead searches across Communications, Marketing, Social, Editorial, Content, Events and related functions. These disciplines require different networks and different ways of evaluating talent. A strong product marketer may need deep technical fluency and launch experience. A communications leader may be judged by the quality of their counsel and writing. A growth marketer needs to show measurable business impact. This is a hands-on, full-cycle recruiting role. You will work closely with Communications and Marketing leaders to define each search, build the market, assess candidates, and close the people who can raise the quality of the work. You should be comfortable reading portfolios and writing samples, digging into campaign results, and separating individual contribution from team output. You will also help us use AI more effectively across recruiting. That means applying it to research, talent mapping, outreach, and workflow automation while maintaining a high bar for judgment and candidate experience. WHAT YOU’LL DO - Own full-cycle recruiting across the Communications & Marketing team. - Partner with Communications and Marketing leaders from intake through close. Turn early or ambiguous briefs into clear candidate profiles, interview plans, and sourcing strategies. - Build talent maps across technology companies, consumer brands, enterprise software, media organizations, and agencies. - Develop sourcing strategies specific to each discipline. Know where strong writers, communications operators, product marketers, and performance-minded marketers build their reputations. - Evaluate candidates beyond titles and company names. Review portfolios and writing samples, understand campaign context, clarify individual ownership, and probe for measurable results. - Help hiring teams build structured work-sample and portfolio reviews that reflect the actual work of each role. - Give leaders direct, useful reads on pipeline quality, candidate tradeoffs, compensation, and the state of the market. - Represent Perplexity clearly and credibly. Explain the product, the pace of the company, and the opportunity without relying on a generic AI pitch. - Run a thoughtful candidate process from first conversation through close, including senior candidates with competing offers and high expectations for the recruiting experience. - Use AI tools for research, sourcing, outreach, and recruiting operations. Identify where automation improves speed and where recruiter judgment needs to stay central. - Track pipeline health and search performance, identify gaps early, and adjust the strategy before a search stalls. WHAT YOU BRING - 7+ years of full-cycle recruiting experience, including meaningful depth across Communications and Marketing. - Experience hiring across several of the following areas: Product Marketing, Corporate or Executive Communications, Editorial, Content, Social Media, Brand, Growth, Demand Generation, Field Marketing, or Events. - A track record of partnering closely with senior Communications or Marketing leaders on important and difficult searches. - Strong functional judgment. You understand the differences between product marketing, communications, editorial, brand, growth, and field marketing, including which backgrounds transfer well between them. - Comfort evaluating portfolios, writing samples, campaign work, and business results alongside the hiring team. - Strong writing and communication skills. You can sharpen a search brief, write credible outreach, and communicate clearly with candidates and executives. - Experience recruiting in a high-growth startup or similarly fast-moving environment. - Hands-on experience using AI tools to improve sourcing, research, outreach, or recruiting workflows. - Fluency with modern ATS and recruiting systems. Experience with Ashby is preferred. - Sound judgment, attention to detail, and the willingness to push back when the market or candidate evidence does not support the original brief. - The ability to manage several distinct searches without giving candidates or hiring teams a generic experience.

items.title: Integrated Marketing Manager - LATAM
items.description: About the Team OpenAI’s LATAM Marketing team helps people understand how AI can benefit their lives and put that value into practice. We connect global product innovation with local consumer needs, culture and behavior across Brazil and Spanish-speaking Latin America, contributing to OpenAI’s mission of ensuring that artificial general intelligence benefits all of humanity. We bring together strategy and creativity across integrated campaigns, product launches, creators, social, partnerships and cultural experiences. Working with global and local cross-functional teams, we make AI’s everyday usefulness tangible and relevant to people across the region. About the Role We are looking for an experienced, hands-on Integrated Marketing Manager to lead consumer marketing programs across LATAM, with an immediate focus on Brazil and close collaboration across Spanish-speaking markets. This role is based in São Paulo, Brazil. You will turn consumer insight and product understanding into a clear strategy, a compelling creative idea and an integrated plan that delivers measurable results. You should be as comfortable exploring an AI product and writing a brief as aligning global stakeholders, guiding creative development and driving execution. Your work will help people discover useful applications of ChatGPT and build confidence in new capabilities. This role is based in Brazil; São Paulo, hybrid model. In this role, you will: - Build consumer strategies from research, market signals and local cultural insight, identifying the audience, unmet need and behavior each program should influence. - Translate product features, AI capabilities and real product behavior into clear consumer use cases, messaging and brand storytelling, with accurate expectations about capabilities and limitations. - Lead integrated campaigns from brief to launch and learning, giving paid, owned, earned, social, creators, partnerships and experiences distinct, complementary roles. - Adapt global launches and campaigns to local needs while protecting the core brand strategy; create locally originated ideas when the opportunity calls for them. - Connect cultural relevance with practical product utility, helping both existing users and new audiences move from discovery to trial, broader usage and repeat engagement. - Partner with creator, social and partnership teams to sustain product education between major launches and turn cultural moments into a consistent marketing presence. - Partner with Product, Product Marketing, Growth, Brand, Creative, Production, Comms, Data and Regional teams to align priorities, messaging, channel plans and launch readiness, including when timelines change quickly. - Define success and learning plans before launch, using relevant brand and behavioral metrics and experimentation where feasible. - Manage campaign resources, agencies, budgets and production dependencies within agreed authority; make clear trade-offs and build forward plans that account for creative lead times and local market conditions. What you bring - 12+ years of technology marketing experience across Brazil and Spanish-speaking LATAM, with a proven record of leading integrated B2C programs and hands-on experience marketing AI products. - Deep local market knowledge and an insight-first approach - Strong product marketing expertise and genuine product curiosity. You explore AI tools yourself and can turn complex capabilities into useful, credible consumer stories. - Strong strategic and creative judgment, connecting brand positioning, product value and distribution to a compelling central campaign idea. - Understanding of the full consumer journey and how marketing contributes to awareness, acquisition, activation, adoption, engagement, retention or monetization, depending on the objective. - Strong measurement and experimentation discipline, with the ability to distinguish activity and platform metrics from business impact and explain attribution limits. - Experience balancing regional consistency with local nuance, and influencing cross-functional and global teams without relying on formal authority. - A clear record of personal ownership: you can set direction, produce high-quality work directly, manage agencies and delivery, and make progress with incomplete inputs and limited resources. - Fluency in Portuguese, English and Spanish, with the ability to communicate clearly and collaborate effectively across local, regional and global teams. Nice to have - An established network of local creative, media, creator or cultural partners, and experience reaching audiences beyond the region’s largest urban centers. - Experience connecting consumer product adoption with professional use cases, or building reusable launch and campaign practices across markets. items.description: About the Team pAGI Infra team builds and operates the systems that make large-scale model training and evaluation reliable, efficient, and easy to run. Our work spans distributed training infrastructure, inference and grading platforms, compute scheduling, and research tooling. We partner closely with researchers and engineering teams to turn new research needs into dependable infrastructure, improve GPU efficiency, and shorten the path from an experiment to a validated model. About the Role We’re looking for an AI Systems Engineer to help scale the infrastructure behind our training and evaluation workflows. You’ll own projects from identifying bottlenecks and designing solutions through deployment and operation. The work combines distributed systems engineering, performance optimization, and close collaboration with researchers. You might build a shared grading service, improve resource allocation across workloads, or bring a new training stack into production — directly improving how quickly and reliably research moves forward. In this role, you will: - Build and operate infrastructure for large-scale training and evaluation, improving reliability, throughput, and resource efficiency. - Develop shared inference and grading platforms with automated capacity management, health monitoring, and visibility into performance. - Improve compute scheduling and resource allocation to reduce idle GPU time and help workloads recover quickly from failures. - Diagnose bottlenecks across training, inference, and orchestration, and work across teams to improve end-to-end performance. - Build self-service tools, automated validation, and observability that help researchers launch experiments, diagnose issues, and compare results with less manual intervention. You might thrive in this role if you: - Are excited about the potential of personal AGI and want to build the infrastructure that enables it. - Have strong software engineering fundamentals and experience building or operating large-scale distributed systems. - Have experience in ML infrastructure, inference systems, GPU performance, or infrastructure tooling. - Are highly self-motivated and comfortable taking ownership of open-ended problems. - Enjoy debugging across system boundaries and using measurements to guide improvements in performance and reliability. items.title: Software Engineer, Ads Integrity
items.description: About the Team The Integrity team builds the systems that protect OpenAI’s products, users, and ecosystem from abuse. We work across product engineering, infrastructure, safety, and operations to detect and prevent harmful, fraudulent, deceptive, and adversarial activity at global scale. As OpenAI builds new ads experiences, we are establishing the integrity foundation that will keep the ads ecosystem safe and trustworthy from the start. This includes protecting advertiser onboarding, detecting unsafe or policy-violating ad content, preventing fraudulent and abusive advertiser behavior, and defending the ads ecosystem against spam, manipulation, and other forms of abuse. Ads Integrity is a new and highly cross-functional area. The team partners closely with Ads, Product, Safety, Policy, ML, Privacy, Security, and operations teams to build protections directly into the ads platform rather than layering them on after the fact. This is an opportunity to define how integrity works for a new ads ecosystem from first principles. About the Role We’re looking for an experienced Software Engineer to build the backend systems and infrastructure that keep OpenAI’s ads products safe, trustworthy, and resilient to abuse. In this foundational role, you will design systems that detect, prevent, and respond to harmful, deceptive, fraudulent, or policy-violating activity across the ads lifecycle. The problems span advertiser onboarding and verification, account and behavioral risk, content safety, spam and fraudulent interactions, detection and enforcement infrastructure, and the systems that connect integrity signals and models to real-time product decisions. This is not an ML-specialist role, but familiarity with ML for Ads integrity is always welcome. You’ll work closely with ML engineers and researchers and build systems that consume and operationalize ML-based signals, but your primary focus will be designing and operating robust backend and distributed systems. You’ll help determine how signals, rules, models, and human review come together into reliable integrity protections for advertisements that can operate at OpenAI scale. This role is particularly well suited to an engineer who has built large-scale systems in integrity, trust and safety, anti-abuse, fraud, risk, security, or a related adversarial domain. You will have significant ownership over what we build and how we build it, partnering across Integrity and Ads to establish the architecture and technical foundations that will protect OpenAI’s ads ecosystem as it grows. This role is based in San Francisco. We offer relocation assistance to new employees. In this role, you will: - Design and build large-scale backend systems that detect and prevent harmful, deceptive, fraudulent, or policy-violating activity across the ads ecosystem. - Build low-latency integrity infrastructure capable of evaluating risk signals and making decisions in or near real time. - Develop scalable risk-signal pipelines, decision systems, rules and enforcement infrastructure across the advertiser and ads lifecycle. - Build advertiser onboarding, business verification, account-risk, fraud-detection, and abuse-prevention capabilities that make it harder for malicious actors to enter or exploit the ecosystem. - Develop systems that support ads-specific content safety and enable the detection and enforcement of unsafe, misleading, deceptive, or policy-violating ads. - Build protections against spam, fraudulent interactions, manipulation, and other adversarial behaviors that threaten the health of the ads ecosystem. - Partner with ML teams to integrate classifiers and model-based signals into production integrity systems, including both lightweight real-time protections and more sophisticated asynchronous detection. - Build feedback loops, review systems, and integrity metrics that improve detection quality while carefully managing false positives and impact on legitimate advertisers and users. - Create tooling and infrastructure that enable operations and policy teams to investigate abuse and make fast, consistent, and explainable decisions. - Engineer systems that adapt as adversaries change their tactics and support effective experimentation, monitoring, and incident response. - Partner closely with Ads Engineering to integrate integrity protections throughout the ads platform without compromising reliability, latency, or product quality. - Help define the technical strategy and architecture for Ads Integrity as both the product and underlying threat landscape evolve. You might thrive in this role if you: - Have significant experience building and operating large-scale backend or distributed systems. - Have worked on integrity, trust and safety, anti-abuse, fraud, risk, security, business verification, or another domain where systems must operate against sophisticated or evolving adversaries. - Have built detection, decisioning, enforcement, verification, investigation, or risk infrastructure in production. - Understand how rules, heuristics, risk signals, ML-based signals, and human review can work together within a dependable production system. - Are comfortable building ML-adjacent infrastructure and partnering closely with ML teams without needing to be an ML domain expert. - Have built low-latency, high-throughput services or data pipelines with demanding reliability, correctness, privacy, and security requirements. - Can reason about false positives, adversarial behavior, explainability, auditability, and the operational impact of automated enforcement. - Think holistically about threat models, system architecture, data quality, observability, user impact, and ecosystem health. - Can define technical direction in an ambiguous 0→1 environment and independently drive complex work across teams. - Communicate clearly and work effectively across engineering, product, policy, safety, security, operations, and machine-learning teams. - Have experience with ads, ads integrity, advertiser systems, or ads fraud. This is a plus, but not a requirement. - Are excited to build the integrity foundation for a new product area rather than inherit a mature system. In this international Government role, you will deliver clearly scoped AI use cases with public-sector customers, from a mission need through hands-on implementation, architecture, evaluations, measurable adoption, and documented handoff. Account-aligned technical and commercial owners retain ongoing account ownership. About the Role We are looking for a driven solutions leader with a product mindset to partner with our international public-sector customers and ensure they achieve tangible value with GenAI. You will pair with government agencies, policymakers, and other public institutions to establish a GenAI strategy and identify the highest value applications. You’ll partner with their technical teams, subject matter experts, regional cloud providers, systems integrators, and implementation partners to move from prototype through production. You’ll design architectures using supported OpenAI technologies and approved services, with explicit data, inference, evaluation, and production-readiness boundaries. You will collaborate closely with regional Sales and Solutions Engineering, Global Affairs, Applied Research, Product, Legal, and Security teams. This role is based in London. We use a hybrid work model of 3 days in the office per week and offer relocation assistance to new employees. items.title: Partner Director, HCL, Wipro & Cognizant
items.description: ABOUT THE TEAM OpenAI's GTM Partnerships team builds a strategic, global partner ecosystem to accelerate customer success, enable enterprise AI adoption, and drive durable growth in support of OpenAI's mission toward AGI. We work cross-functionally across Product, Engineering, Security, Legal, Marketing, Customer Success, and Sales to turn strategic partnerships into measurable business outcomes. This role sits within the GTM Partnerships organization and is responsible for leading OpenAI's strategic relationships with three of the world's largest Global Systems Integrators (GSIs): HCLTech, Wipro, and Cognizant. These partners play a critical role in helping enterprise customers design, deploy, and scale AI solutions by combining OpenAI's technology with deep industry expertise, consulting capabilities, and global delivery organizations. This role reports to the Head of GSIs and will be responsible for driving executive alignment, joint go-to-market strategy, commercial execution, and scalable partnership programs across these strategic accounts. ABOUT THE ROLE We are hiring a Partner Director, HCL, Wipro & Cognizant to lead and grow three of OpenAI's most strategic Global Systems Integrator partnerships. You will own executive relationships, develop and execute joint business plans, and drive coordinated go-to-market motions that accelerate customer adoption and revenue growth. This is a highly strategic, externally facing role that requires a blend of executive relationship management, commercial leadership, operational excellence, and ecosystem expertise. You'll work closely with OpenAI Sales, Solutions Engineering, Customer Success, Product, Marketing, Legal, Security, and partner leadership teams to build repeatable motions that generate pipeline, enable successful customer deployments, and deepen long-term strategic alignment. The ideal candidate understands how large consulting organizations operate, has experience driving revenue through strategic partnerships, and thrives in fast-paced, highly collaborative environments where they can build new programs while scaling existing ones. The Fraud Investigator (Customer Protection Team) is responsible for handling inbound customer calls for customers with an active fraud alert and account restriction. The team investigates fraud alerts, determining fraud or no fraud utilizing tools and investigative skills, and helping identify emerging fraud trends through data analysis. The team works directly with the customer via phone to gather additional information to help make a fraud determination on their account. This role is based in our Lake Mary, Florida or Denver, CO office(s), with in-person attendance expected at least 3 days per week. Communicating with customers next steps and setting expectations. items.title: Technical Program Manager, Science Operations, Code
items.description: ABOUT MISTRAL Mistral provides full-stack AI solutions: from frontier models to developer tools, applications, and compute. We partner with enterprises tackling the hardest problems across high-stakes industries like finance, manufacturing, defense, healthcare, and the public sector, co-creating customized AI systems that they can run on their terms. We are a dynamic, collaborative team passionate about AI and its potential to transform society. Our diverse workforce thrives in competitive environments and is committed to driving innovation. Our teams are distributed between Europe, North America, Asia and the Middle East. We are creative, low-ego and team-spirited. THE ROLE We're hiring a Technical Program Manager to partner with Mistral's code and vibe research team - the researchers shaping how our models write, reason about, and play with code. You'll be their operational counterpart - the person who absorbs what the team is working on and makes it legible to the team, to leadership, and to adjacent teams. This isn't a coordination role. It's a research partnership role - embedded with the team, fluent in what they're building, and operationally responsible for everything that isn't the science itself. The ideal candidate is someone who is genuinely excited about code models. You play with them. You have opinions about what makes them feel good to use. You read the papers because you want to, not because you have to. A research background is a plus but not required - what matters is that you care about this domain and can hold your own in a room full of researchers working on it. WHAT WILL YOU DO - Research Visibility: Partner with the team to maintain a shared, accessible view of their ongoing work - what's in flight, where it's heading, what's ready to hand off. Make the research legible to adjacent teams and leadership without pulling researchers into status work. - Operational Partnership: Be the team's operational partner. Handle the coordination, resourcing, and cross-team conversations that would otherwise sit on researchers' plates - so the team can stay focused on the science. - Research-to-release: Own the operational path from research work to release candidate for code and vibe workstreams. Partner with the release function to ensure the team's work flows cleanly into Mistral's release machinery. - Visibility & Communication Cadence: Code and vibe research connects to many other efforts across the organization. Keep these interfaces clean and high-signal, so the team's work integrates naturally with the wider science org. - Strategic Communication: Translate the team's work into clear, well-timed updates for leadership and adjacent teams - what's being built, what matters, what's coming next. WHAT WE'RE LOOKING FOR - Genuine enthusiasm for code models and coding assistants - you play with them, push them, have opinions about them - Bachelor’s degree in Computer Science, Engineering, or related field, or equivalent practical experience - 3+ years of experience in technical program management, operations, or research coordination - Strong analytical skills; comfortable working in ambiguity and shaping it into structure - Ability to engage substantively with research work and build real credibility with technical teams - Excellent written and verbal communication; able to translate technical detail into clarity for different audiences Nice to have criteria/ would be ideal if you have/are: - Experience in research-heavy or ML/AI organizations - Familiarity with code generation, coding agents, software engineering benchmarks, or related research areas - Hands-on experience with modern coding tools - you're a user, not just an observer - Track record of building systemic processes from the ground up - Comfort working in fast-paced, high-ambiguity environments where priorities shift quickly WHY JOIN US? - Shape how frontier AI is built and released: You’ll design and operate the systems that connect scientific discovery to real-world deployment - ensuring our work scales with clarity, reliability, and speed - Work inside the Science OS: Join a team building the operational backbone of Mistral’s science organization - where structure meets creativity and processes evolve through use, not bureaucracy - Drive visible, high-leverage impact: Your work will sit at the intersection of research, engineering, and leadership - turning complexity into alignment and enabling confident, data-informed decisions across the company WHAT WE OFFER We offer a comprehensive benefits package designed to support your well-being, growth, and work-life balance. Benefits vary by country and may include healthcare coverage, parental leave, retirement plans, relocation support, wellness programs, meal and transportation allowances, and other location-specific perks. For the most up-to-date details on benefits available in your location, please refer to our Benefits page https://app.notion.com/p/mistralai/Benefits-at-Mistral-36e6ba59a7fe836b93dd01737fcc27ef?source=copy_link. PRIVACY POLICY Your privacy matters to us. You can learn more about how we handle your personal data in our Applicant Privacy Policy https://legal.mistral.ai/terms/applicant-privacy-policy.

The North Security team is looking for a Senior Software Engineer to create autonomous systems that handle the complex, critical tasks security practitioners face every day. KEY RESPONSIBILITIES As a Senior Software Engineer focused on agentic security, you'll build intelligent systems that empower security teams. Your responsibilities will include: - Build autonomous security agents that perform alert triage, secure code reviews, threat modeling, and vulnerability assessment - Develop agent orchestration systems that help security practitioners automate repetitive security tasks - Design and implement agent security controls to ensure our AI agents can safely interact with sensitive enterprise data - Create the security infrastructure that allows agents to operate in high-trust environments with stringent deployment requirements - Ship production-ready agent capabilities that run efficiently in resource-constrained environments - Research and implement novel security patterns for AI agent systems, sometimes requiring custom solutions where standard libraries fall short - Conduct security testing of both the agents you build and the platform that runs them. This is one of two roles in Krak’s Product Ops function, reporting to the Manager, Product Ops - Krak. THE OPPORTUNITY Product Ops at Krak is a co-ordination and intelligence function. Your job is to make sure that the cross-functional dependencies that could slow or derail delivery are surfaced early, actively managed, and resolved. You'll also help the team make better product decisions by curating the right operational data and bringing market and vendor intelligence into the room. You'll work across four areas: compliance and risk co-ordination, third party vendor management, responding to management information (MI) and feature performance, and strategic market intelligence. items.title: Service Operations Manager
items.description: ABOUT THE ROLE The Service Operations Manager is responsible for the reliable, continuous delivery of production monitoring and identity & access management services across LeoVegas. The role combines people leadership of a shift-based engineering team with operational ownership of access governance, ensuring both functions run with consistency, discipline, and clear escalation paths. This is a people-first leadership role. The manager owns team health, shift rhythm, process adherence, and cross-functional coordination, serving as the primary operational liaison between Service Operations and the rest of the Technical Operations department. YOU WILL BE RESPONSIBLE FOR: Operational leadership & shift management - Own the day-to-day running of a 24/7 shift-based monitoring operation, ensuring handovers are structured and documented. - Maintain shift coverage, manage rota planning, and oversee escalation readiness at all times. - Act as the primary point of escalation for shift engineers during major incidents, supporting war room coordination and live documentation. - Ensure production monitoring activities align with agreed SLAs, detection standards, and escalation procedures. - Review and continuously improve shift handover quality, ensuring knowledge transfer between rotations. Identity & access management oversight - Oversee the onboarding and offboarding process for all company employees, ensuring timely, accurate, and compliant access provisioning. - Ensure periodic access reviews are completed on schedule across all managed systems. - Maintain compliance with internal access policies and relevant regulatory requirements (MGA, UKGC, SPA, and others as applicable). - Act as the accountable owner for access governance, working with the Identity & Access Analysts to continuously improve procedures. Cross-functional coordination - Serve as the primary interface between Service Operations and the Incident Management function, ensuring events are correctly escalated, classified, and handed over. - Coordinate with Change Management on maintenance windows, PR reviews, and go-live readiness activities. - Work closely with the Observability & Engineering Manager to surface operational pain points, monitoring gaps, and manual toil that require tooling or automation investment. - Participate in new market and provider onboarding processes, maintaining checklists and ensuring regulatory notification requirements are met. People & performance management - Lead regular 1:1s, performance conversations, and development planning for all direct reports. - Manage team wellbeing and engagement, with particular attention to the challenges of shift-based working patterns. - Identify training needs and support certification or skills development where appropriate. - Onboard new team members effectively, maintaining and improving onboarding documentation. Process & governance - Own and maintain operational runbooks, escalation playbooks, and standard operating procedures for the Service Operations team. - Ensure all monitoring activities comply with the Datadog governance standards set by the Observability & Engineering team. - Support certification readiness activities by ensuring operational processes meet required compliance standards. - Conduct or facilitate post-shift reviews following major incidents, feeding findings into the wider incident management process. OUR SUCCESSFUL CANDIDATE WILL HAVE THE FOLLOWING: The essentials skills you bring to the team: - Proven experience managing a shift-based operations or NOC team in a 24/7 environment. - Strong understanding of production monitoring principles, event management, and incident escalation. - Experience managing identity & access management processes, including onboarding, offboarding, and access reviews. - Demonstrated ability to lead and develop a team of 8+ people across multiple disciplines. - Familiarity with ITIL frameworks, particularly Service Operation and Incident Management practices. - Strong communication skills, able to represent operational concerns clearly to senior stakeholders. Nice to have: - Previous experience in an iGaming, fintech, or regulated technology environment. - Hands-on experience with Datadog or equivalent observability platforms. - ITIL Foundation certification or above. - Experience working across multiple regulatory jurisdictions (SGA, MGA, UKGC, ADM, etc.). WHO WE ARE At the core of LeoVegas Group is Team Leo. Our culture is our foundation and is what enables us to innovate, build, and lead as we trailblaze our way through the igaming industry. We’re a team of over 2000 innovators, initiators, and groundbreakers working in a fast-paced and agile environment across 19 offices worldwide. BENEFITS - 4 weeks of Workation (T&C apply) - Well-being allowance to support your active lifestyle - Private health insurance - Discounts across a range of retailers, gyms, bars & restaurants - We offer an employee assistance program that can provide help and guidance during challenging moments. JOIN US! In our pride, we empower our teammates to find their roar and run with their wildest ideas. We don’t wait for things to happen; we pounce and make it happen! Would you be a good fit for the Leo Pride - give us a roar! As our company working language is English, we’d like to see your CV in English, please

items.description: ABOUT MISTRAL Mistral provides full-stack AI solutions: from frontier models to developer tools, applications, and compute. We partner with enterprises tackling the hardest problems across high-stakes industries like finance, manufacturing, defense, healthcare, and the public sector, co-creating customized AI systems that they can run on their terms. We are a dynamic, collaborative team passionate about AI and its potential to transform society. Our diverse workforce thrives in competitive environments and is committed to driving innovation. Our teams are distributed between Europe, North America, Asia and the Middle East. We are creative, low-ego and team-spirited. The Role As an Applied Engineering Intern, you will work closely with our Applied AI Engineering team to facilitate the adoption of Mistral AI products among customers and collaborate with them to address complex technical challenges. This role is based in Paris, with an internship duration of 6 months. We are open to CIFRE programs as a continuation after the internship. What you will do • Contribute to the deployment of state-of-the-art GenAI applications, driving technological transformation with our customers. • Collaborate with researchers, AI engineers, and product engineers on complex customer projects. • Work with the product and science team to continuously improve our product and model capabilities based on customer feedback. How We Work in Applied AI - We care about people and outputs. - What matters is what you ship, not the time you spend on it - Bureaucracy is where urgency goes to vanish. You talk to whoever you need to talk to. The best idea wins, whether it comes from a principal engineer or someone in their first week. - Always ask why. The best solutions come from deep understanding, not from copying what worked before - We say what we mean. Feedback is direct, timely, and given because we care. - No politics. Low ego, high standards. - We embrace an unstructured environment and find joy in it. About you • You are currently pursuing a degree in AI, data science, or a related field from a tier 1 engineering school or university. • You have strong programming skills in Python. • You are familiar with machine learning algorithms and natural language processing techniques. • You hold basic understanding of MLOps and deploying machine learning use cases. • You have good communication skills with the ability to explain technical concepts to both technical and non-technical audiences. Ideally you have: • Experience with deep learning frameworks such as PyTorch. • Familiarity with version control systems (e.g., Git) and Linux shell environment. • Experience working in HPC Environments • Publication record in AI or a related field Location & work authorization: This internship is available only in France. Please apply only if you have the required work authorization to complete the internship in the relevant country for its full duration. WHAT WE OFFER We offer a comprehensive benefits package designed to support your well-being, growth, and work-life balance. Benefits vary by country and may include healthcare coverage, parental leave, retirement plans, relocation support, wellness programs, meal and transportation allowances, and other location-specific perks. For the most up-to-date details on benefits available in your location, please refer to our Benefits page https://app.notion.com/p/mistralai/Benefits-at-Mistral-36e6ba59a7fe836b93dd01737fcc27ef?source=copy_link. PRIVACY POLICY Your privacy matters to us. You can learn more about how we handle your personal data in our Applicant Privacy Policy https://legal.mistral.ai/terms/applicant-privacy-policy.

items.title: Forward Deployed Engineer
items.description: About Anthropic Anthropic’s mission is to create reliable, interpretable, and steerable AI systems. We want AI to be safe and beneficial for our users and for society as a whole. Our team is a quickly growing group of committed researchers, engineers, policy experts, and business leaders working together to build beneficial AI systems. About Anthropic Anthropic’s mission is to create reliable, interpretable, and steerable AI systems. We want AI to be safe and beneficial for our users and for society as a whole. Our team is a quickly growing group of committed researchers, engineers, policy experts, and business leaders working together to build beneficial AI systems. As a member of the Applied AI team at Anthropic, you will be a Forward Deployed Engineer (FDE) who embeds directly with our most strategic customers to drive transformational AI adoption. You will collaborate closely with customer teams to ship advanced AI applications that solve real world business problems. Our FDEs engage with customers to accelerate the adoption of existing products and create new applications built on our models. Working closely with our Post-Sales, Product, and Engineering teams, you'll combine engineering expertise, an understanding of frontier AI applications, and customer-facing skills to understand customer workflows and develop innovative solutions that address complex business challenges while maintaining our high standards for safety and reliability. You will sit at the frontier of enterprise AI deployments and serve as one of our founding FDEs who helps to shape our forward-deployed motion. We expect our FDEs to operate autonomously, thrive under ambiguity, and represent Anthropic at the highest level in customer environments. This is a significant responsibility: you’ll play a key role in championing our mission in the enterprise. Responsibilities Work within customer systems to build production applications with Claude models, ensuring that these products meet customer requirements. Deliver technical artifacts for customers like MCP servers, sub-agents, and agent skills that will be used in production workflows. Provide white glove deployment support for Anthropic products in enterprise environments. Identify and codify repeatable deployment patterns and contribute insights back to our Product and Engineering teams. Maintain strong knowledge of the latest developments in LLM capabilities, implementation patterns, and AI product development stacks. Build long term relationships with customers and proactively identify new opportunities for AI deployment throughout the lifecycle of an engagement. Travel frequently (25-50%) to customer sites to build in person with customers. Be a champion for Anthropic’s mission in the field. You May Be a Good Fit If You Have 4+ years of experience in a technical, customer facing role such as Forward Deployed Engineer, or as a Software Engineer with consulting or product experience. Former technical founders are also encouraged to apply. Production experience with LLMs including advanced prompt engineering, agent development, evaluation frameworks, and deployment at scale. Strong programming skills with proficiency in Python (and ideally in one or more additional languages like TypeScript, Java, etc) and experience shipping production applications High agency with an ability to navigate ambiguity present in complex organizations. High cooperation mindset for cross-organizational collaboration, balancing competing priorities with integrity. Passion for advancing safe, beneficial AI systems through creative technical applications. Strong communication skills to conduct discovery with customers and to convey technical concepts to diverse stakeholders while maintaining a low ego and collaborative approach. A background in financial services, healthcare/life sciences, or another enterprise vertical is a plus. Experience with enterprise IT systems and/or AI deployment patterns is a plus. The annual compensation range for this role is listed below. For sales roles, the range provided is the role’s On Target Earnings ("OTE") range, meaning that the range includes both the sales commissions/sales bonuses target and annual base salary for the role. Annual Salary: £225,000 — £255,000 GBP Logistics Minimum education: Bachelor’s degree or an equivalent combination of education, training, and/or experience Required field of study: A field relevant to the role as demonstrated through coursework, training, or professional experience Minimum years of experience: Years of experience required will correlate with the internal job level requirements for the position Location-based hybrid policy: Currently, we expect all staff to be in one of our offices at least 25% of the time. However, some roles may require more time in our offices. Visa sponsorship: We do sponsor visas! However, we aren't able to successfully sponsor visas for every role and every candidate. But if we make you an offer, we will make every reasonable effort to get you a visa, and we retain an immigration lawyer to help with this. We encourage you to apply even if you do not believe you meet every single qualification. Not all strong candidates will meet every single qualification as listed. Research shows that people who identify as being from underrepresented groups are more prone to experiencing imposter syndrome and doubting the strength of their candidacy, so we urge you not to exclude yourself prematurely and to submit an application if you're interested in this work. We think AI systems like the ones we're building have enormous social and ethical implications. We think this makes representation even more important, and we strive to include a range of diverse perspectives on our team. Your safety matters to us. To protect yourself from potential scams, remember that Anthropic recruiters only contact you from @anthropic.com email addresses. In some cases, we may partner with vetted recruiting agencies who will identify themselves as working on behalf of Anthropic. Be cautious of emails from other domains. Legitimate Anthropic recruiters will never ask for money, fees, or banking information before your first day. If you're ever unsure about a communication, don't click any links—visit anthropic.com/careers directly for confirmed position openings. How we're different We believe that the highest-impact AI research will be big science. At Anthropic we work as a single cohesive team on just a few large-scale research efforts. And we value impact — advancing our long-term goals of steerable, trustworthy AI — rather than work on smaller and more specific puzzles. We view AI research as an empirical science, which has as much in common with physics and biology as with traditional efforts in computer science. We're an extremely collaborative group, and we host frequent research discussions to ensure that we are pursuing the highest-impact work at any given time. As such, we greatly value communication skills. The easiest way to understand our research directions is to read our recent research. This research continues many of the directions our team worked on prior to Anthropic, including: GPT-3, Circuit-Based Interpretability, Multimodal Neurons, Scaling Laws, AI & Compute, Concrete Problems in AI Safety, and Learning from Human Preferences. Come work with us! Anthropic is a public benefit corporation headquartered in San Francisco. We offer competitive compensation and benefits, optional equity donation matching, generous vacation and parental leave, flexible working hours, and a lovely office space in which to collaborate with colleagues. Guidance on Candidates' AI Usage: Learn about our policy for using AI in our application process.

items.title: B2B Marketing Manager, DACH
items.description: About the Team Like every team at OpenAI, the Marketing team contributes directly to our mission of responsible and widespread AI adoption. The EMEA B2B Marketing team translates global priorities into regionally relevant programs that drive awareness, consideration, pipeline, adoption, and long-term customer trust. We partner closely with Sales and GTM, Product Marketing, Field and Executive Marketing, Content, Customer Marketing, Partner Marketing, Comms, Events, Marketing Operations, and regional leadership. DACH is one of OpenAI’s most important markets in EMEA. Our opportunity spans major enterprises and digital natives, ambitious startups, developers, partners, and a highly influential business community navigating the adoption of AI. About the Role As the B2B Marketing Manager for DACH, you will own the integrated B2B marketing strategy and execution for Germany, Austria, and Switzerland. You will be a close commercial partner to local Sales and GTM leadership, translating market insight, revenue priorities, target-account needs, and global launches into locally relevant programs that create pipeline, accelerate complex opportunities, deepen customer relationships, and grow adoption. You will carry clear pipeline goals and be accountable for Marketing’s measurable contribution to commercial outcomes in DACH. These goals will be established through the regional planning process and will evolve with the priorities and maturity of the market. You will be expected to understand the pipeline, make informed investment decisions, and demonstrate how marketing activity creates, influences, or accelerates revenue opportunities. This is a generalist role spanning field and executive marketing, demand generation, account-based programs, content, customer marketing, partnerships, events, and product launches. You will bring these channels together into a focused DACH B2B plan, drawing on specialist capabilities within the EMEA B2B Marketing team in London and global Marketing teams. A particularly important partnership will be with the DACH Consumer Marketing Lead: together, you will align market strategy, narratives, launches, audience priorities, channels, and major moments so B2B and B2C activity is coordinated, complementary, and mutually reinforcing. Close partnership with Marketing Operations will be crucial. Together, you will establish campaign infrastructure, audience and account segmentation, attribution, reporting, and operating rhythms that give Sales and Marketing a reliable view of performance and inform where the team should invest next. The role requires someone who can move comfortably between strategy and execution: shaping the market plan, participating in pipeline reviews, developing a priority-account program, adapting a global campaign, briefing an agency, supporting an executive event, and personally unblocking delivery when needed. This role is preferably based in Munich. Berlin may be considered for an exceptional candidate. Regular travel within DACH and to London will be required. We've grown quickly, but we've worked hard to keep what matters: trust, ownership, and the freedom for people to do great work without unnecessary layers or bureaucracy. We're fully remote by design, genuinely global, and united by a shared mission to make travel simpler for everyone. Your Next Destination Location: Remote, anywhere in Spain, the UK, or the UAE. items.description: WE ARE BETCLIC 🎯 Betclic est un acteur européen majeur du pari sportif et du jeu en ligne, proposant des activités de paris sportifs, de poker, de courses hippiques et de casino sur plusieurs marchés. Notre mission est de faire grandir la passion du sport et du jeu en proposant une expérience de divertissement innovante, dans un environnement sécurisé et responsable. Avec environ 1 600 collaborateurs répartis dans cinq pays et un siège basé à Bordeaux, Betclic est une entreprise internationale, moderne et profondément technologique. Chez Betclic, la Data n’est pas une fonction support : des dizaines de modèles et de produits data tournent en production et contribuent directement à l’expérience de millions de joueurs. Vous rejoindrez une équipe Data Science de plus de dix personnes, dont quatre docteurs, qui travaille au quotidien avec les équipes Produit, Engineering, MLOps et Jeu Responsable. WHY JOIN US? 🚀 Cette opportunité combine un programme de recherche ambitieux avec un environnement industriel concret : • Une thèse CIFRE de 3 ans avec un CDI dès l’embauche • Un sujet de recherche directement lié au jeu responsable et à des décisions produit concrètes • Des données comportementales et transactionnelles à grande échelle, des systèmes de recommandation en production et un environnement d’expérimentation • Un environnement international et créatif dans lequel la Data Science a un impact visible • Un accès à Claude et une culture encourageant l’usage responsable de l’IA générative pour la recherche, le prototypage, l’analyse et la rédaction ENTER THE GAME 🎮 En tant que doctorant·e CIFRE, vous rejoindrez l’équipe Data Science de Betclic et travaillerez sur un sujet à l’intersection de la modélisation séquentielle, de la personnalisation, des sciences comportementales et du jeu responsable. La thèse sera menée en partenariat avec le laboratoire IMS Bordeaux et l’ENSC Bordeaux INP. Le ou la doctorant·e sera inscrit·e à l’école doctorale Sciences Physiques et de l’Ingénieur (SPI) de l’Université de Bordeaux. La question centrale est la suivante : comment comprendre ce qu’un joueur cherche à faire à un instant donné, plutôt que seulement ce qu’il a aimé dans le passé, afin d’adapter son expérience en temps réel tout en donnant la priorité à sa protection ? YOUR RO LE WITHIN BETCLIC 🔥 Le sujet de thèse proposé est : « De la pertinence de l’item au pilotage de l’expérience : comprendre l’état de session d’un joueur pour personnaliser l’expérience en temps réel, sous contraintes de jeu responsable. » Le sujet sera précisé avec le ou la candidat·e retenu·e et le laboratoire académique avant le dépôt du dossier auprès de l’ANRT. Vos travaux de recherche s’articuleront autour de trois objectifs complémentaires : • Estimer un état de session latent à partir de séquences d’événements incomplètes, en tenant compte de l’incertitude et des changements de régime comportemental. • Dépasser le simple classement d’items et étudier une politique d’adaptation au niveau de l’expérience, capable de choisir entre plusieurs actions : recommander, informer, favoriser la découverte, ou ne rien pousser. • Intégrer le jeu responsable comme contrainte prioritaire de la décision, à partir de signaux précoces, incertains et évolutifs observés au cours de la session. Le travail s’appuiera sur la comparaison de deux environnements contrastés, les paris sportifs et le Casino, ainsi que sur un accès direct à des systèmes en cours de déploiement en production. WHO ARE WE LOOKING FOR? 🔍 Nous recherchons une personne curieuse et rigoureuse, qui apprécie les problèmes ouverts et souhaite relier recherche scientifique et impact concret. • Vous êtes titulaire, ou bientôt titulaire, d’un Master 2 ou d’un diplôme d’ingénieur en statistiques, mathématiques appliquées, Data Science, Machine Learning, informatique, cognitique ou dans un domaine proche. • Vous êtes récemment diplômé·e ou disposez d’une à deux années d’expérience en industrie en Data Science, Machine Learning, R&D ou analyse de données, et souhaitez vous engager dans une thèse. • Vous avez une réelle appétence pour les statistiques, la modélisation et l’analyse de données comportementales. • Vous êtes intéressé·e par la cognition, les intentions, les comportements humains ou les interactions entre individus et systèmes numériques. • Vous savez formuler des hypothèses, construire un protocole expérimental et interpréter rigoureusement des résultats. • Vous êtes à l’aise avec Python et disposez de bonnes bases en SQL. • Vous communiquez clairement avec des interlocuteurs scientifiques, techniques et métier. • Vous êtes autonome, curieux·se, rigoureux·se et appréciez le travail collaboratif. Une expérience ou des connaissances en recommandation, personnalisation, modèles séquentiels ou probabilistes, états latents, quantification de l’incertitude, évaluation de systèmes adaptatifs, sciences cognitives ou jeu responsable seront appréciées. Une appétence pour le sport, le gaming ou les environnements produits est un plus, mais n’est pas indispensable. WHAT ARE THE RECRUITMENT STEPS? 📝 Si votre candidature est présélectionnée, vous aurez d’abord un échange avec les Ressources Humaines, puis un entretien avec le Head of Data Science consacré à votre parcours, vos motivations et au sujet de thèse. Vous échangerez ensuite avec les encadrants académiques lors d’un entretien scientifique, avant un dernier entretien RH. Le processus pourra être adapté au profil du ou de la candidat·e et à l’avancement du projet CIFRE. Le sujet présenté constitue une base de travail : vos intérêts scientifiques et vos premières propositions contribueront à construire le programme de recherche final avec Betclic et le laboratoire académique. WHAT CAN YOU EXPECT? 🎁 • Un CDI dès l’embauche dans le cadre d’une thèse CIFRE de 3 ans • Une rémunération attractive positionnée au niveau d’un poste de Junior Data Scientist chez Betclic • Un double encadrement industriel et académique au sein d’une équipe Data Science expérimentée et collaborative • Des données réelles, des systèmes en production et un environnement d’A/B testing • 25 jours de congés payés et 10 jours de RTT • Une carte Ticket Restaurant® créditée de 11 € par jour, dont 6 € pris en charge par Betclic • Une mutuelle santé prise en charge à 100 % pour vous et vos enfants • 50 % de remboursement des transports en commun ou une indemnité annuelle de mobilité durable • Un modèle de télétravail hybride et l’accès à un large catalogue de formation • Des cours de sport sur site, des événements internes et des locaux avec rooftop et vue sur la Cité du Vin CDI basé à Bordeaux Betclic Group – 117 Quai de Bacalan, 33300 BORDEAUX

items.description: Kick-start your career in the online gaming world and experience the very latest in technology and innovation. Who we are We’re Super Group, the NYSE-listed digital gaming company behind some of the world’s leading Sports and iGaming brands, including Betway and Jackpot City. We’re a powerhouse built on decades of expertise and we’re changing the game for good. Our mission is to give our customers a superclass entertainment experience. Who we’re looking for We’re on a thrilling journey of growth and innovation, and we need passionate, driven individuals to join us. At Super Group International, every day is action-packed, and we expect you to bring your A-game. In return, you’ll find a supportive environment where your skills can flourish and your career can soar. Ready to become a game-changer? Supercharge your career with us and be part of something extraordinary. Why we need you We’re building experiences that wow our customers – and that starts with bold, curious people who want to do work that matters. If you’re hungry to grow, excited by impact and ready for a challenge that will supercharge your career, this could be your moment. The ASO Specialist will drive mobile marketing efforts across 15+ brands, promoting iOS and Android apps with a global presence. Working alongside another ASO team member, this role is responsible for delivering impactful results through user acquisition strategies, conversion rate optimizations, and continuous support for app release and updates. What you’ll do You’ll take ownership of work that gives us our competitive edge, including: Own and optimize our apps across all markets, primarily on the App Store and Play Store. Develop and execute ASO strategies to enhance app visibility, increase downloads, and improve conversion rates. Optimize metadata including titles, descriptions, keywords, and visual assets, to boost visibility, rankings, and user acquisition. Run A/B tests on store assets and analyze results to inform ongoing optimization. Drive mobile innovation by staying up to date with the latest ASO trends, platform updates, and industry best practices. Conduct in-depth competitor analysis to uncover trends and growth opportunities. Collaborate with cross-functional teams to align ASO efforts with regular app release cycles and ensure readiness. Support the launch of new apps, features, and updates with tailored ASO strategies. Partner with product and marketing teams to drive promotions, including In-App Events. Manage multiple projects and timelines while coordinating with relevant stakeholders. Maintain strong and effective cross-team collaborations and relationships. Briefing, management, and research of projects in relevant systems. Maintain app store accounts and manage user access across all platforms. The conceptualization and implementation of ideas throughout the business. Ensure internal documentation and knowledge bases are regularly updated with new and existing processes. Manage communications with suppliers, agencies, and strategic partners. This list covers your core responsibilities – with plenty of room to stretch, explore and take on new challenges as we grow. What you’ll bring You’re someone who brings: Minimum 1 years’ working experience managing ASO on the App Store and Google Play, or relevant marketing experience. Experience managing apps on the App Store and Play Store Experience developing and executing successful ASO strategies that drive measurable results. Excellent communication skills, with the ability to translate complex ASO results into clear, actionable insights. Highly analytical with experience using ASO and app performance tools such as AppTweak, SensorTower, App Store Connect, and Google Play Console. Proficient in reporting and data visualization using tools like Power BI, Tableau, or Excel. Effective cross-functional collaborator, able to work seamlessly with performance marketing, creative, product, and analytics teams. Exceptional attention to detail, with strong organizational and prioritization skills Desirable skills you’ve got up your sleeve It would be great if you also have some the following skills: In-depth knowledge of sports betting markets, including odds calculation, betting types and market trends Previous experience in the online gaming or casino industry, with a strong understanding of player behaviour and industry regulations Familiarity with gambling regulations and compliance requirements in various jurisdictions, ensuring adherence to legal standards A passion for and knowledge of casino games. Experience in iGaming, regulated industries, or working with fast-paced digital products. Exposure to App Marketing platforms like AppsFlyer, Sensor Tower, App Annie etc Our values are non-negotiables Our culture is underpinned by core values that are linked to key behavioural competencies. Along with the below behavioural competencies, these are essential for all employees in order for you to embed in and drive our culture forward. These competencies are: Adaptability Ownership and accountability Initiating action Resilience Team orientation Integrity Innovation What you’ll get back We invest in your growth and wellbeing, so you can bring your best: Supergrowth is real here. Our learning and development programmes give you the tools, training and opportunities to level up fast. Your progress matters . Our Performance tool ensures you get meaningful feedback to support your development and superdrive your career. Support that has your back . Our Employee Assistance Programme offers resources for you and your family. Vitality Health Care Unum Dental Life Assurance & Income Protection Tusker car scheme Cycle to Work Retail discounts Ready to feel superclass? At Super Group, your experience matters. We’re honest, fair, and focused on helping you succeed – and your work will have real impact from day one. Game on! *Please note we will apply relevance to our Talent Management and Talent Development Programme as part of our recruitment process. *Shortlisted candidates may need to complete an assessment. This position requires trust and honesty it has access to customers financial details - therefore a credit and criminal record check will be conducted. The qualifications identified herein are an inherent job requirement; therefore, a qualification verification check will be done. By applying for this role, and supplying the necessary details, you hereby grant us permission to apply for these checks. This will be done in a confidential manner, and solely for the purposes of verification. Should you not hear from us within 2 weeks, please deem your application as unsuccessful. The perfect place to work, play and grow!

items.description: Perplexity is seeking a TLM (Tech Lead Manager) to lead and grow our highly driven Agents engineering team. The Agents team consists of AI/ML, backend, and full-stack engineers who collaborate to build delightful agentic experiences within our Comet ecosystem https://www.perplexity.ai/comet. Our vision is to empower our users with AI agents that can faithfully actualize their intent, however and wherever expressed, through open-ended interactions with the world. As the Agents TLM, you will bring AI expertise, sharp product intuition, and strong engineering management skills to advance the frontier of what agents can accomplish for our millions of devoted users. You will lead, grow, and support a team in solving many open problems in AI, including: - Designing AI agents to navigate the digital world and perform increasingly valuable units of work for our users; - Training action and decision models that determine, based on complex multimodal states, how to accomplish user-specified objectives; - Providing consistently excellent experiences across desktop, mobile, headless cloud, and other environments through flexible abstractions and frictionless backgrounding; - Developing permission architectures, payload classifiers, and other methods to implement secure-by-design agentic capabilities; - Designing optimal data representations and modes of interaction between agents and their environments; - and much, much more. items.title: Enforcement Operations Lead, Cloud Partners
items.location_text: San Francisco, CA | New York City, NY | Washington, DC
items.description: About Anthropic Anthropic’s mission is to create reliable, interpretable, and steerable AI systems. We want AI to be safe and beneficial for our users and for society as a whole. Our team is a quickly growing group of committed researchers, engineers, policy experts, and business leaders working together to build beneficial AI systems. About the Role Anthropic's Safeguards team is responsible for enforcing our policies, protecting users, and ensuring our platform is not misused. A large and growing share of Claude usage reaches customers through our cloud partners: Amazon Bedrock, Google Cloud's Agent Platform, and Microsoft Foundry. As the Enforcement Operations Lead for Multi-Cloud, you'll own how Anthropic detects, reviews, and acts on misuse across those surfaces, where the partner owns the customer relationship and often the data path. You'll build the operating model, partner agreements, and documentation that make enforcement on every cloud consistent, auditable, and fast. This role requires someone who is detail-oriented, comfortable navigating ambiguity, and capable of coordinating across teams and companies to break new ground and drive work to completion. This work is deeply cross-functional. You'll partner closely with our product managers, policy experts, Safeguards engineering, Legal, and the trust & safety and operations teams across our Cloud partners to maintain a consistent and safe enforcement ecosystem. Important context for this role: In this position you may be exposed to and engage with explicit content spanning a range of topics, including those of a sexual, violent, or psychologically disturbing nature. Key responsibilities Own the end to end enforcement lifecycle on partner surfaces, from detection and review through action, customer communication, and appeal Define enforcement paths for each partner's operating model, including how actions are requested, executed, and confirmed when the partner controls the account Manage SLAs for review, escalation, and action, and evaluate performance against them on an ongoing basis Develop and maintain SOPs and escalation guides for all enforcement workflows, ensuring consistency across clouds Establish red-teaming, Quality processes, and operationalize shared metrics Stand up paired investigations with partner threat intelligence teams, including case referrals, indicator sharing, and paging for high severity incidents Own enforcement metrics across partner surfaces and report them to Safeguards leadership, partners, and regulators Minimum qualifications Extensive experience in trust and safety operations, enforcement, threat intelligence, or a related field Have managed external partner or vendor relationships where you did not control the other side's systems or priorities Comfortable working across policy, legal, engineering, and operations teams to translate requirements into practical workflows Experience building enforcement programs from the ground up, including SLAs, escalation paths, and quality measurement Highly organized, with a track record of maintaining rigorous documentation and SOPs in fast-moving environments Clear and precise communication, both in writing and verbally, across technical and non-technical audiences, including partner executives Energized by the challenge of building scalable systems in an environment where not everything is already figured out Care deeply about the responsible deployment of AI and the role enforcement operations plays in that mission Preferred qualifications Direct trust & safety, abuse, or security operations experience at AWS, GCP, or Azure, or at a company that ships through their marketplaces Experience designing incident response or escalation processes that span more than one company Familiarity with data access controls, audit requirements, or privacy constrained review environments Experience with law enforcement referrals, regulatory reporting, or compliance programs Background in AI safety, content moderation, fraud, or abuse detection systems Comfort working with data and metrics to inform operational decisions and surface trends to leadership The annual compensation range for this role is listed below. For sales roles, the range provided is the role’s On Target Earnings ("OTE") range, meaning that the range includes both the sales commissions/sales bonuses target and annual base salary for the role. Annual Salary: $285,000 — $330,000 USD Logistics Minimum education: Bachelor’s degree or an equivalent combination of education, training, and/or experience Required field of study: A field relevant to the role as demonstrated through coursework, training, or professional experience Minimum years of experience: Years of experience required will correlate with the internal job level requirements for the position Location-based hybrid policy: Currently, we expect all staff to be in one of our offices at least 25% of the time. However, some roles may require more time in our offices. Visa sponsorship: We do sponsor visas! However, we aren't able to successfully sponsor visas for every role and every candidate. But if we make you an offer, we will make every reasonable effort to get you a visa, and we retain an immigration lawyer to help with this. We encourage you to apply even if you do not believe you meet every single qualification. Not all strong candidates will meet every single qualification as listed. Research shows that people who identify as being from underrepresented groups are more prone to experiencing imposter syndrome and doubting the strength of their candidacy, so we urge you not to exclude yourself prematurely and to submit an application if you're interested in this work. We think AI systems like the ones we're building have enormous social and ethical implications. We think this makes representation even more important, and we strive to include a range of diverse perspectives on our team. Your safety matters to us. To protect yourself from potential scams, remember that Anthropic recruiters only contact you from @anthropic.com email addresses. In some cases, we may partner with vetted recruiting agencies who will identify themselves as working on behalf of Anthropic. Be cautious of emails from other domains. Legitimate Anthropic recruiters will never ask for money, fees, or banking information before your first day. If you're ever unsure about a communication, don't click any links—visit anthropic.com/careers directly for confirmed position openings. How we're different We believe that the highest-impact AI research will be big science. At Anthropic we work as a single cohesive team on just a few large-scale research efforts. And we value impact — advancing our long-term goals of steerable, trustworthy AI — rather than work on smaller and more specific puzzles. We view AI research as an empirical science, which has as much in common with physics and biology as with traditional efforts in computer science. We're an extremely collaborative group, and we host frequent research discussions to ensure that we are pursuing the highest-impact work at any given time. As such, we greatly value communication skills. The easiest way to understand our research directions is to read our recent research. This research continues many of the directions our team worked on prior to Anthropic, including: GPT-3, Circuit-Based Interpretability, Multimodal Neurons, Scaling Laws, AI & Compute, Concrete Problems in AI Safety, and Learning from Human Preferences. Come work with us! Anthropic is a public benefit corporation headquartered in San Francisco. We offer competitive compensation and benefits, optional equity donation matching, generous vacation and parental leave, flexible working hours, and a lovely office space in which to collaborate with colleagues. Guidance on Candidates' AI Usage: Learn about our policy for using AI in our application process.

items.title: Software Engineer, Consumer Health
items.description: OpenAI’s Health AI team is working to ensure that advances in AI meaningfully improve health for everyone. We build AI systems that help people better understand and navigate their health while setting a high bar for safety, reliability, privacy, and user trust. On the Consumer Health team, we’re building health experiences directly into ChatGPT. People can use ChatGPT to understand health information, prepare for appointments, make sense of changes over time, and have more informed conversations grounded in their own health context. Our work sits at the intersection of consumer product engineering, AI, and healthcare. We work closely with product, design, research, safety, privacy, and other ChatGPT teams to build experiences used at global scale. ABOUT THE ROLE We are looking for product-minded software engineers to build the next generation of consumer health experiences in ChatGPT. You will own products and features end-to-end, from early prototypes through polished experiences used by millions of people. We welcome specialists in mobile, frontend, or full-stack development; you can focus on the area where you have the most depth. This role is ideal for engineers who care deeply about craft and user experience, move quickly from idea to product, and are excited about making complex health information understandable and useful. Prior healthcare or AI experience is not required. IN THIS ROLE, YOU WILL: - Design and build consumer health experiences across ChatGPT, including mobile, web, and full-stack product surfaces. - Own features end-to-end, from early product exploration and prototyping through implementation, launch, measurement, and iteration. - Build intuitive experiences for helping people understand and interact with complex personal health information. - Work closely with product managers, designers, researchers, and safety experts to translate emerging AI capabilities into useful consumer products. - Build experiences that let people connect their medical records, health apps, and connected devices, explore their health over time, and get useful answers grounded in their personal context. - Develop reliable systems and interfaces for highly sensitive user data, with privacy and security built into the product experience. - Improve product quality, performance, reliability, and usability at ChatGPT scale. - Take ownership of ambiguous problems and drive them toward practical, high-quality solutions. YOU MIGHT THRIVE IN THIS ROLE IF YOU: - Are an exceptional product engineer who has shipped consumer-facing products and cares deeply about usability, performance, and craft. - Have 5+ years of experience building and shipping production software. - Have deep experience in at least one of mobile, frontend, or full-stack product development. - Enjoy working closely with design and product partners and contributing to product direction, not just implementation. - Can take ownership of ambiguous problems and move quickly from prototype to production while maintaining a high quality bar. - Are excited about the opportunity to use AI to help people better understand and manage their health. - Are thoughtful about the responsibilities that come with building products involving sensitive health information. BONUS IF YOU HAVE: - Experience building high-quality consumer products at significant scale. - Experience building AI-powered or conversational products. - Experience working with personal data, health data, wearables, or health platforms such as Apple Health. - Experience building products where privacy, safety, and user trust are core product requirements. - Previous experience in healthcare or health technology. About OpenAI OpenAI is an AI research and deployment company dedicated to ensuring that general-purpose artificial intelligence benefits all of humanity. This requires a breadth of new ML research to address the growing set of safety challenges as AI becomes more powerful and used in more settings. Key focus areas include how to train nuanced safety behaviors, how to make the model robust to bad actors, how to address privacy and security risks, and how to make the model trustworthy in safety-critical situations.
